decision: Personal-first with near-term multi-user commercialization; preserve tenant and deployment foundations from the start.
Primary purpose is portfolio-aware decisions plus frequent trading signals.
A useful no-paid-market-data baseline must not require paid AI; hosting and optional providers are separate.
Mandatory discovery is US-listed stocks and ETFs with currency-aware accounts.
First release proposes specific actions but never submits, modifies or cancels broker orders.
Both hosted and complete self-hosted editions are release requirements.
Initial commercial audience includes Canadian and US residents.
Intraday swing discovery plus optional same-day opportunities; no sub-minute scalping requirement.
Frequent evaluation means timely qualifying changes, not a quota of trades.
Separate investing and trading allocations with portfolio-wide limits.
Free mode may require a user-connected free provider account/key.
Stale or unreconciled holdings/cash block affected portfolio-specific sizing.
Independent open-source core and complete self-hosted application; no mandatory vendor-operated service.
Prioritized live monitoring plus broader scheduled discovery; tracked and streamed universes differ.
Auditable rules and AI research both originate proposals; a separate agent evaluates actionable AI-mode proposals.
MCQs and necessary numeric/date inputs propose a policy/strategy shortlist for explicit runtime approval.
Opt-in first-release options include long calls/puts, covered calls, cash-secured puts and defined-risk verticals.
API and subscription access use provider-specific officially permitted routes and deployment qualification.
Mandatory evidence/calculation verification is tiered; separate model review is required for AI-mode actions.
Action proposals expire and have invalidation conditions plus preserved version history.
Commercial legal and provider-rights clearance are release gates.
Apache-2.0 is the selected application license, superseding AGPL proposals.
Support audited rules-only and AI-enabled modes; evaluator covers both proposal origins in AI mode.
AI proposals qualify through evaluated research workflows and proposal-specific checks, not necessarily a backtested rule.
Evaluator is a separate run/context; a different model family is optional and empirically justified.
Material factual/evidence conflicts and hard risk failures block; forecast differences may be disclosed; revisions bounded.
Frequent deterministic monitoring; AI on meaningful events/schedules/requests within budgets and deadlines.
All six improvement targets are in scope, including code and the optimizer itself.
Promotion uses predeclared scorecards with hard risk/privacy/evidence constraints, not recent returns alone.
Autonomous authorized experiments, human-controlled promotion of investment-affecting or code changes.
Private learning per user/installation by default; cross-user use requires separate consent and permitted data.
Separate experiment resource budgets; current monitoring and verification take priority.
All six improvement areas, code-level change and recursive optimizer change must work at first release.
Material changes to enabled investment strategies require user adoption after release approval.
Personal pilot incremental inference ceiling USD100/month; improvement maximum 20 percent (USD20).
Single-machine container self-hosting without required Kubernetes/GPU/vendor service.
Demonstrate V0 optimizer proposing V1, independent evaluation, human promotion, then V1 running next cycle.
Generated code is isolated from production secrets, DB writes, unrestricted network and host control.
User learning is tenant-scoped; shared executable/optimizer changes are installation/release scoped.
Open evaluation framework and permitted starter corpus; distinguish synthetic/historical/prospective evidence.
Full scope and release gates take precedence over launch date; budget limits throughput rather than silently cutting scope.
Partial portfolios allowed with scoped conclusions; outside-coverage assets retained with gaps.
Multiple accounts/currencies with account-specific spendability and consolidated risk.
Stock/ETF proposals cash-funded long-only, nonleveraged/noninverse; approved options remain.
Primary and permitted independent sources; optional social inputs clearly distinguished from facts.
Tax-relevant records and warnings, not a comprehensive tax engine or automated tax-loss harvesting.
Responsive web, in-app feed, configurable email/browser push; no native mobile/SMS launch requirement.
Small named set of tested read-only broker sync routes; CSV/manual fallback.
Proposals form jointly feasible sets with explicit alternatives and internal capital commitments.
Initial actionable intraday proposals are regular-session only; research may run outside session.
Hosted/self-hosted migration is supported at first release.
Tamper-evident retained history, not indefinite private retention; explicit correction/deletion/backups.
CIBC import, Questrade/IBKR read-only sync, plus Wealthsimple sync and Yahoo CSV interoperability.
Reference scale: 10 accounts, 250 instruments, 100000 records/user; hosted 100 users and 20 concurrent sessions.
Managed service pricing plus user-connected providers; independent self-hosted core and unbiased rankings.
Dashboard-led portfolio/decision/research/governance workspaces; chat uses same verified state.
Yahoo tested CSV portfolio/watchlist import and compatible export; no auto-sync/data-adapter launch promise.
Underlying accounts and data sources are separate; reconcile overlapping views without duplication.
All six versioned stock/ETF strategy families required; qualification status separate from catalogue inclusion.
Conservative liquidity/spread/data/status-screened universe; optional speculative research cannot bypass gates.
Bounded versioned strategy configuration, not unrestricted hosted arbitrary-code or visual strategy builder.
Free baseline supports portfolio-specific rebalancing plus a qualified non-intraday long-only strategy.
User-facing application-managed virtual portfolios and optional approved-policy shadow tracking.
Versioned goal-appropriate/cash-flow-matched benchmarks and separate actual/simulated/recommendation scorecards.
Separate operational qualification, investment evidence and user eligibility; family-specific actionable-use gates.
Versioned feed specifications and qualified continuity/reinitialization for provider changes.
Targets: 95 percent factual events within 5s of receipt; rules-only within 15s; AI intraday deadline at most 60s or earlier expiry.
Explicit approved numerical account/allocation/concentration/planned-loss/scenario limits for sizing.
Scoped loss/drawdown triggers pause new risk; monitoring and checked risk reduction continue; controlled resumption.
Typed Python core, TypeScript/React, PostgreSQL, analytical file/object storage and durable jobs; three authority paths.
Reconciled decimal journal with explicit effective/publication/receipt/decision times; one calculation contract.
Interpretable six-family starting implementations; 6-month/200-day momentum and 15-minute ORB are unqualified research defaults.
Capability/rights/degraded-state registry; provider/entitlement changes require reassessment.
Persisted bounded workflows, explicit model/runtime versions, no silent paid/provider fallback.
Read-only operation allowlists, secrets outside agents, tenant isolation including nonowner/nonbypass DB roles.
gVisor initial Linux sandbox qualification target; full recursive scope; reviewed signed promotion and compatible rollback.
Hosted targets 99.9 percent availability, 15-minute RPO and 4-hour RTO; receipts not guarantees.
End-to-end release journeys cover free mode, overlap, AI, intraday, options, risk pause, simulation, improvement, migration and isolation.
Separate design choices from factual provider/legal/security/performance/economic gates.
